preservedLogic: Equally moving items keep their relative free gaps.
Connected belts form transport lines; store gaps.
Unobstructed flow changes only the two terminal gaps.
Blocking consumes the last positive gap inside the line.
Remember its index rather than rescanning every item.
Inserting/removing items and crossing line boundaries need extra handling.

thesis: The same visible belt flow can require fewer position-state updates when unchanged internal distances are stored explicitly.

toyModel.counts: 4 changed coordinate fields versus 2 changed terminal-gap fields in this small example. Not a Factorio timing benchmark or total CPU-operation count.
toyModel.blockedRule: With right boundary fixed, clamp the first item at12 and each following item's left edge to the next left edge minus1. The last positive gap shrinks; already compressed pairs remain packed until insertion/removal changes the model.

scopeConditions: Historical2017v0.15 optimization, not an assertion of the latest entire engine implementation.
Equal-speed internal-gap invariance applies to unobstructed flow, not all blocked or inserter states.
Items still exist, move, render and transfer. This does not eliminate all simulation/render costs.
No invented FPS, CPU percentage, benchmark or performance multiplier.
Branch and line-boundary handling remain; narration includes insertion/removal and visual note may name boundary transfers.
